convertibility_reason: Uses only built-in iBands indicator with standard params. Simple Bollinger Band breakout entry/exit logic. Fixed or balance-based lot sizing. Trade library includes (CTrade, CPositionInfo, etc.) are standard MT5 Trade library wrappers, not custom logic. No iCustom, no multi-timeframe, no hedging, no grid, no martingale scaling beyond simple balance-proportional lots.

derived_values.name: ExtProfitMade - adjusted profit target in points
derived_values.used_by: take_profit exit rule and SL/TP price calculation

derived_values.name: ExtLossLimit - adjusted stop loss in points
derived_values.used_by: stop_loss exit rule and SL/TP price calculation

derived_values.name: ExtBDistance - adjusted breakout distance in points
ExtLots - dynamic lot size when LotIncrease=true

params.note: SL = Price +/- (ExtLossLimit + 10) * Point; ExtLossLimit = InpLossLimit * digits_adjust
TP = Price +/- (ExtProfitMade + 10) * Point; ExtProfitMade = InpProfitMade * digits_adjust

other_exits: Soft profit/loss close: On each tick, if open position profit in points >= ExtProfitMade * Point, close position for profit. If profit <= -ExtLossLimit * Point, close for loss. These are additional soft exits independent of the broker-side SL/TP set at order open.

position_sizing.conditional_logic: If LotIncrease=true, lots = NormalizeDouble(Balance / StartingBalance, 1), capped at 500.0; if LotIncrease=false, lots = InpLots (fixed). StartingBalance = AccountBalance / ExtLots at initialization.

custom_logic_notes: EA uses a dual exit system: (1) broker-side SL/TP set at order open with +10 extra points beyond the input values, and (2) soft tick-level monitoring that closes positions when unrealized profit >= ExtProfitMade*Point or unrealized loss <= -ExtLossLimit*Point. The OneOrderOnly flag controls whether only one position at a time is allowed (default true). When OneOrderOnly=false, TradeAllowed flag resets on new bar to allow one entry per bar. Entry signals are mean-reversion style: buy when price closes below lower band minus distance, sell when price closes above upper band plus distance.
python_conversion_notes: 1. Standard MT5 Trade library includes - all have equivalent Python mt5 library calls. 2. The digit_adjust logic (multiply by 10 for 5-digit brokers) must be replicated: check symbol digits, if 3 or 5 then multiply input pip values by 10. 3. iBands with PRICE_OPEN (applied_to=1) - use mt5.copy_band_from_indicator or compute from open prices. 4. Soft exit monitoring requires checking open position profit on every tick - implement in main loop. 5. The LotIncrease feature needs account balance tracking - straightforward with mt5.account_info(). 6. Entry uses iClose(0) which is the current bar's close (bar index 0) - in Python backtesting this means current candle close. 7. The +10 point offset on SL/TP prices at order open vs the soft exit thresholds (without +10) means broker SL/TP are wider than the soft close targets - the soft close will typically trigger first. 8. New bar detection via iTime comparison - replicate with timestamp tracking.
